# GoDaddy

donepudi.me is registered at GoDaddy, with auto-renew on. Its name servers point at the zone in the Cloudflare account `swarupdonepudi`: the pair in `Infra.prod.CloudflareDnsZone.donepudi-me`'s `status.outputs.nameservers` (erin and maxim, `ns.cloudflare.com`). They're set with GoDaddy's `gddy` CLI after a sign-in that adds the `domains.nameserver:update` scope.
